sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:99

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:99:1
items.html: The surrounding lights of nursing and the inner lights of the VAK [six ends] of Gadlut enter together, one after the other: Over the course of the seven years, as explained in the adjacent item, that first the inner lights of the VAK of Gadlut come, whose meaning is the growth of the vessels in the new NHY; and after he has ten vessels, the surrounding lights of the LM [Lamed-Mem] of the Tzelem of nursing, called the surrounding lights of Katnut, are able to enter.
